name: Journalism
notes: Six courses, five of which must be taken while at the University of Rochester. No more than two courses in one's major may overlap with the minor.
The practicum option ENGL 388+389 is a two-course pair; the app models the practicum group as single courses, so choosing that route consumes two of the six.
Any remaining courses may be chosen from the 200- and 300-level courses in literature or criticism.

requirementGroups.label: News reporting and feature writing
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: ENGL 131: Reporting and Writing the News; ENGL 132: Feature Writing

requirementGroups.label: Writing or rhetoric course
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: At least one of the following: ENGL 105: Intro to Rhetoric; ENGL 121: Creative Writing: Fiction; ENGL 122: Creative Writing: Poetry; ENGL 125: Speculative Fiction; ENGL 138: Journalism Case Studies; ENGL 281: Creative Nonfiction; ENGL 282: Humor Writing; ENGL 283: Journalism and Media (Topics)

requirementGroups.label: Editing, practicum, independent study or internship (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: At least two of the following: ENGL 133: Editing; ENGL 388+389: Practicum in Academic Publishing and Editing I + II; ENGL 391: Independent Study (in Journalism); ENGL 394: Internship

requirementGroups.label: Literature or criticism at the 200-300 level
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Additional courses can be chosen from the 200- and 300-level courses in literature or criticism.
